name: CanyonTrip

framework_config.system_prompt: You are generating a conversation between two people hiking in a canyon. They are passionate and curious about the geological features and want to learn as much as possible about the geology.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Nature sounds, birds chirping, water flowing, footsteps on rocks

initial_prompt: Generate a conversation between two people hiking in a canyon. They are passionate and curious about the geological features and want to learn as much as possible about the geology.

user1.name: User1
user1.role: A curious and enthusiastic person interested in geology.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: An energetic hiker that loves exploring nature.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Smaert assistant that provides information about geology and answers questions about the canyon.

variations.context: User are looking at geological formations and other features of the canyon. They want to know more about them.

setting.background: They ask a lot of trivia questions about the canyon.

scenario_template.note: The users are discussing about how the hike in the canyon was a great idea and they are having a great time.
The users stop to look at a cool rock formation. They admire the colors and patterns in the rock.

The users wonder how such a beautiful rock formation came to be. They ask the assistant about the geological processes that could have created it. The assistant explains the formation process in an engaging and informative way.
The users discuss the unique features and geological history of the canyon. The assistant provides interesting facts and explanations.
The users end their discussion about the rocks and focus on the rest of their hike.
